steps: Make the sauce: in a bowl, mix light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, ground black pepper, cooking wine, starch, and 1/2 bowl water until combined. (先调一个酱汁：碗中加入生抽+老抽+蚝油+胡椒粉+料酒+淀粉+半碗清水搅拌均匀。)
Blanch the beef rolls in boiling water for 30 seconds, until they change color. Remove and set aside. Slice the onion. (肥牛卷放入开水中，焯30秒变色捞出备用，洋葱切丝。)
Heat oil in a pan, add the sliced onion, and stir-fry until softened. (锅热入油，放入洋葱丝翻炒变软。)
Add the beef rolls and stir-fry until evenly mixed. (放入肥牛卷炒匀。)
Pour in the prepared sauce. Stir-fry evenly and cook until the sauce thickens. Garnish with a little chopped scallion if desired. (淋入调好的酱汁，翻炒均匀煮至粘稠即可。最后可加入一点葱花点缀。)
Serve directly over rice as a beef rice bowl. (直接淋在米饭上变成肥牛盖浇饭！开吃🍚！)
